maya (docs): quick check before i merge the quota-playbook PR: two small items
1) the SDK header example for x-redwood-usage-tier — runtime changed expected format to use `tier=...` but backwards-compatible for a bit
2) the embeddings dashboard link i swapped, but not sure about panelId and metric rename

jordan (pm): paste the exact header snippet you have and the grafana link please

maya (docs): current draft snippet in the playbook:

```http
POST /v1/embeddings
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY
Content-Type: application/json
x-redwood-usage-tier: tier:free
```

and grafana link i put in docs: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ef12gh34/usage-quickview?orgId=1&view=embeddings

sam (eng): header note: router now prefers `tier=free` (equals) — we accept both `tier:free` and `tier=free` for ~48h for compatibility. please show both examples and recommend `tier=...` for new integrations. also metric rename: use `metering.embeddings.tokens.total` (panel id on that dashboard is 9).

maya (docs): ok will add both forms and a migration callout. would this sentence work? "Both `tier:free` and `tier=free` are accepted; new integrations should use `tier=...`."

jordan (pm): yes. also add a short note about legacy burst credits: older customers may see a transient allowance applied before tier enforcement — link to pricing page.

maya (docs): adding a concise paragraph and the pricing link. adding compact SDK snippets for python and node (for examples folder):

python:
```py
import os
import requests
headers = {
  "Authorization": f"Bearer {os.getenv('RW_KEY')}",
  "Content-Type": "application/json",
  "x-redwood-usage-tier": "tier=free"  # also accepts "tier:free" for now
}
resp = requests.post("https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings", json={"model":"v-embed-1","input":"hello"}, headers=headers)
print(resp.status_code)
```

node:
```js
await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.RW_KEY}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    'x-redwood-usage-tier': 'tier=free' // legacy 'tier:free' accepted
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'v-embed-1', input: 'hello' })
})
```

maya (docs): grafana link updated to include panel id + timeframe per sam: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ef12gh34/usage-quickview?orgId=1&view=embeddings&panelId=9&from=now-7d&to=now

sam (eng): confirmed. also FYI i pushed a tiny router change to keep accepting `tier:free` for compatibility; staging has the change.

finance (billing): quick note for the billed-token mapping: please add this one-line mapping in the playbook near the dashboard link: `metering.embeddings.tokens.total -> billed tokens (post-normalization & rounding)`. i'll follow up if we need to call out price-per-token buckets.

maya (docs): added the mapping and a link to the consumption guide. pinging finance for ack. plan is to merge after finance confirms wording, then backport snippets to the sdk-samples repo.
